```python
def rearrange_bigger(n):
    """Return the next bigger number formed by rearranging n's digits, or False if none exists."""
    digits = list(str(n))
    # Rightmost ascent: the first position from the right whose digit is smaller than its right neighbour.
    i = len(digits) - 2
    while i >= 0 and digits[i] >= digits[i + 1]:
        i -= 1
    if i < 0:
        return False
    # Smallest digit to the right of i that is still larger than digits[i].
    j = len(digits) - 1
    while digits[j] <= digits[i]:
        j -= 1
    digits[i], digits[j] = digits[j], digits[i]
    # Sort the suffix ascending (it is descending before the swap, so reversing sorts it).
    digits[i + 1:] = reversed(digits[i + 1:])
    return int(''.join(digits))
```
